title: Game Event, Scene & Automation Binding
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-27 America/Chicago after fresh verification of AIOC main ca9d9b71ccc6456b4ec7d269a8f3992ac928eb63 and application main fb8cae52fd5bf9eaf0cf826bd9f19dd65a9e4884, re-reading AAI-01..06 completion evidence and resolving the bounded deterministic gameplay-signal-to-audio binding contract before implementation.
objective: Implement and prove deterministic non-authoritative binding from existing canonical gameplay event, scene-lifecycle and automation-output signals to existing audio cues/soundscapes and completed AAI playback behavior without creating or mutating gameplay truth.

signals.identity_rule: Every signal carries a stable caller signalId and an existing AAI-02 owner reference. AAI-07 consumes the signal as immutable gameplay truth and never creates, rewrites, advances, cancels or persists that truth.

bindings.target_rule: A binding targets only an existing AAI-02 cueId or soundscapeId and matches an explicit owner authority/stableId plus signal class. Provider-native identity is never a gameplay binding key.
bindings.ordering_rule: Matched bindings execute in ascending authored order with stable bindingId ascending as tie-break.
bindings.lifetime_rule: Bindings are signal-lifetime or scene-lifetime presentation behavior only. Scene-lifetime start is permitted on scene-enter; scene-exit may request cancellation only for caller-supplied active audio handles associated with the same canonical Scene/Tabletop owner reference.

idempotency.rule: The deterministic idempotency key is signalId + bindingId. Caller-supplied previously-applied keys produce explicit duplicate-suppressed nonblocking receipts and no second action. AAI-07 owns no durable idempotency ledger.

cancellation.rule: Cancellation generates presentation-only stop requests against caller-supplied active audio handles. Missing, mismatched or unknown handles fail closed to explicit nonblocking no-op receipts and cannot mutate gameplay/scene lifecycle.

audio_resolution.rule: Existing AAI-02 cue/soundscape identities are consumed. AAI-05 semantic resolution and AAI-04 playback/layer/mixer outcomes remain binding. Unresolved, silent, manual, unavailable and degraded audio remain nonblocking. AAI-07 cannot promote rights, capability, terms/entitlement, semantics, runtime availability or AAI-06 adapter authority.

owners.rule: MIB-11/D18 World, Scene/Tabletop, Event, Combat/Exploration, Action, Visibility/Permissions and D29 authoring-provenance remain canonical. AAI-07 receipts and requests are presentation/support state only.

persistence.result: No durable canonical AAI-07 runtime persistence required. Binding definitions are repository/caller-owned declarative configuration; applied keys and active handles are ephemeral/caller-owned runtime inputs.

nonauthorization: provider-specific transport changes beyond completed AAI-06

validation_contract.focused: Prove deterministic signal matching, authored ordering, owner nonmutation, idempotency, scene-lifetime start/cancel, fail-closed handle matching, nonblocking unavailable audio and preservation of all completed AAI gates.
validation_contract.predecessors: Run AAI-06, AAI-05, AAI-04, AAI-03, AAI-02 and AAI-01 verifiers plus MIB-11/D18 World-owner regression on both required platforms.
validation_contract.workflow: Register AAI-07 in Repository Health path coverage and the canonical self-hosted Validation Core discovery workflow; do not add a fourth workflow namespace.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows AAI-07 Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison and declared predecessor/owner regressions before merge.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01..06 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-07 authority is limited to deterministic presentation-only binding on integration/aai-07-game-event-scene-automation-binding
audio can consume but never create or mutate gameplay truth
rights/provenance, capability, provider terms/entitlement, semantic compatibility, runtime availability and AAI-06 adapter restrictions remain independent and fail closed
next_action: Implement only bounded AAI-07 on integration/aai-07-game-event-scene-automation-binding from application baseline fb8cae52fd5bf9eaf0cf826bd9f19dd65a9e4884; add deterministic binding contracts/scenarios/documentation/verifier/integration regression and AAI-07 Validation Core wiring; preserve gameplay owners and completed AAI-01..06 behavior; then exact-head Repository Health + self-hosted Linux/Windows + deterministic comparison before merge.
